Intro: My friend! What did you think about the promotion on the radio? My work in the press has kept my hands quite full as of late. I presume you enjoyed the helping hand?
Keep this up, and I'm sure I can remind our friend to continue showing her support for your establishment.
Anywho, I would love to have some [DISH].
Success: My dear friend, your establishment is truly one-of-a-kind. You have my number; I'll make sure to give you a call soon. I'm sure good things will come your way.
Fail: It's not your best quality, but it's satisfactory, at least. I'll reach out to you soon about any opportunities with our friend.
Reject: Tch, what is with this sudden change of heart? I thought we were comrades, friend. It's alright. I'm sure my dear friend will have something to say.
